sources.name: Senja free and paid plan comparison
Reddit discussion of testimonial tools including Senja

claims.statement: Senja collects text and video testimonials through a shareable form, imports existing proof, organizes it, and displays it in website widgets or public pages.
Free includes 15 total text and video testimonials, one form, one project, one seat, Senja branding, and unlimited widgets.
After the 15th testimonial, forms still accept submissions but later testimonials stay hidden until the account upgrades.

Starter is $29 monthly with unlimited testimonials, three forms, two seats, custom branding, HD export, auto-sync, Zapier, API, and webhooks. Pro is $59 with unlimited forms, five projects, and five seats.
Easy collection, a simple interface, organization, and website display are repeated strengths.
Pricing, some imports or integrations, and finding the right testimonial are reported limits.
Login failures, missing testimonials, and poor support appear in a five-review Trustpilot sample and should be treated as test and backup warnings, not a normal outcome.

scoreRationale.onboarding: A single form and website widget are easy to understand.
scoreRationale.product: Collection, organization, and display fit together well for a focused job.
scoreRationale.support: The larger samples are positive, but a very small service-review sample contains serious reliability complaints.
scoreRationale.billing: Free is enough for a real test. The jump to $29 happens quickly once a business has more than 15 testimonials.
scoreRationale.overall: Senja is useful when testimonials are scattered and hard to publish, but it cannot make vague praise convincing.

conflictsAndUnknowns: G2 is 4.6 from 20 while Trustpilot is 3.1 from five.
Some G2 reviews are marked incentivized.
No hands-on form, embed, export, or recovery test was completed.
